200.description:
The anonymous quick-view data for one IronPlanet item by `equip_id`: the inspection-report photo sections (`inspectionReport.do`: status code, total photo count, section names and photo URLs) and the preview info (`getEquipInfo.jsp`: features, serial number, meter reading, quantity). The full item page (`/for-sale/...`, specifications, bids) is behind an AWS WAF CAPTCHA and is not available; `item_url` points at it. An unknown id is `not_found`.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `equip_id` | string |  |
| `features` | string[] | Feature list from the preview info; null when the preview info endpoint returned nothing for this id. |
| `item_url` | string | Public item URL `https://www.ironplanet.com/jsp/s/item/{equipId}` (WAF-protected, not fetched). |
| `meter` | string | Meter reading as displayed, e.g. `1,559 Hours`. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the program read the source (`observed_at_ms`). |
| `photo_sections` | object[] |  |
| `preview_info_available` | boolean | False when `getEquipInfo.jsp` answered empty for this id; `features`, `serial_number`, `meter` and `quantity` are then null. |
| `quantity` | number |  |
| `serial_number` | string |  |
| `status_code` | number | The site's numeric `eqStatus`. |
| `total_photos` | number | Total photo count the inspection report declares. |

200.description:
One page of the lot listing of an IronPlanet online auction (`/jsp/s/auction.ips?msg={sale_group_id}`), same item shape as `list_equipment` (the bid URL points at the auction bid page and `sale_date` carries the sale day). Sort and page size as on the site; paginate with `continuation`. An unknown sale group id is `not_found` (the site falls back to its auction calendar).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |
| `attendees` | number | `Auction Attendees` count shown in the auction header, when present. |
| `items` | object[] |  |
| `next_offset` | number | Offset of the next page; null when this page is the last. Also returned as the continuation cursor. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the program read the source (`observed_at_ms`). |
| `offset` | number | Zero-based offset of the first item on this page (`pstart`). |
| `page_size` | number | Items per page requested (20, 60 or 100). |

| `title` | string | Page heading (`<h1>`) or `<title>` without the site suffix. |
| `total` | number | Total matching items the site reports (`sr_total_results`). 0 for a genuine empty result. |

post.description: Browse or filter equipment for sale by category or make; discover filter values via `include_facets`; paginate with `continuation`.

category_slug.description: Path segment of a category or make listing page, as in the site's URLs: `Excavators`, `Bobcat`, `Truck+Tractors`, `Skid+Steer+Loaders`, `Cat-Excavators`. Spaces are accepted and encoded as `+`. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 +._&',()-]*$.

continuation.description: Continuation cursor: the `next_offset` of the previous page as a decimal string. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,7}$.

include_facets.description: Also return the page's facet links (type, buying format, make, location, year, price, marketplace) with counts.

ironclad_assurance.description: Only items with (true) or without (false) IronClad Assurance (`ica`).

location.description: Location code (`l2`): a country (`USA`, `CAN`, `MEX`) or country-region (`USA-TX`). Pattern: ^[A-Z]{2,3}(-[A-Z0-9]{2,3})?$.

marketplace.description:
Marketplace (`ms`): I IronPlanet, M Marketplace-E, T TruckPlanet, G GovPlanet, R Ritchie Bros. Auctioneers, S SalvageSale.

Provider reference: allowed values ["I", "M", "T", "G", "R", "S"].

page_size.description:
Items per page (`prows`).

Provider reference: allowed values ["20", "60", "100"]; default 20.

price_bucket.description:
USD price bucket lower bound (`p_us`): -1 any USD price, 1000, 5000, 10000, 50000, 100000, 500000, 1000000.

Provider reference: minimum -1.

sale_format.description:
Buying format (`fp`): D any auction, A online auction, L on-site auction, S sealed auction, B Buy Now, M Make Offer.

Provider reference: allowed values ["D", "A", "L", "S", "B", "M"].

sort.description:
Sort key as the site encodes it: `bm asc` Best Match, `p asc`/`p desc` price, `d asc` closest to the exit IP (not reproducible), `ad asc`/`ad desc` ending sooner/later, `yr desc` year (newest first).

Provider reference: allowed values ["bm asc", "p asc", "p desc", "d asc", "ad asc", "ad desc", "yr desc"]; default "bm asc".

type_id.description:
Sub-type id within the category (`t`), e.g. 12912 Tracked Excavator; discover via `include_facets`.

Provider reference: minimum 1.

url.description: Alternatively a pasted listing URL such as https://www.ironplanet.com/Excavators?c=3&sm=0&m=Bobcat; its slug and recognised query parameters are used.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
One page of IronPlanet's server-rendered listing for a category or make slug (`/Excavators`, `/Bobcat`, `/Truck+Tractors`, `/Cat-Excavators`), with optional make, type, location, buying-format, marketplace, year, price and IronClad filters, sort and page size, plus the facet vocabulary when `include_facets` is set. Items come from the page's embedded `quickviews` JSON (id, title, URL, displayed price and currency, location, meter, features, marketplace, sale format/date, photos). Free-text keyword search is not available anonymously (the site's `search.ips` is behind AWS WAF); use `suggest` to map a keyword to a category/make first. An unknown slug is `not_found`; the site may resolve a misspelt slug to a near category or make, `canonical_url` and `resolved` show what was actually listed.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `canonical_url` | string | The page's `<link rel=canonical>`; differs from the requested slug when the site resolved it to another category or make. |
| `category_slug` | string | Slug actually requested. |
| `facets` | object[] | Present only when `include_facets` is true. |
| `items` | object[] |  |
| `next_offset` | number | Offset of the next page; null when this page is the last. Also returned as the continuation cursor. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number | Unix epoch milliseconds when the program read the source (`observed_at_ms`). |
| `offset` | number | Zero-based offset of the first item on this page (`pstart`). |
| `page_size` | number | Items per page requested (20, 60 or 100). |
| `resolved` | object | Search parameters the site echoed back for this page. |
| `source_url` | string | The URL fetched. |
| `title` | string | Page heading (`<h1>`) or `<title>` without the site suffix. |
| `total` | number | Total matching items the site reports (`sr_total_results`). 0 for a genuine empty result. |
